description: This file defines the TenantAmqpEndpoint class in Java, which manages tenant information via an AMQP endpoint in the Eclipse Hono framework. It extends RequestResponseEndpoint, handles authorization, message creation, and response filtering for tenant-related requests, and interacts with the vertx event bus.

classes.name: TenantAmqpEndpoint
classes.description: A class extending RequestResponseEndpoint to implement a tenant management endpoint over AMQP, handling authorization, message creation, and response filtering.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the endpoint, as defined in TenantConstants.

methods.name: getEventBusServiceAddress
methods.description: Provides the address on the Vert.x event bus for tenant requests.

methods.name: isAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if a client principal is authorized to perform an operation on a resource, considering tenant ID presence.

methods.name: filterResponse
methods.description: Filters responses to ensure the client is authorized to see tenant information.

methods.name: createEventBusRequestMessage
methods.description: Constructs an EventBusMessage from an AMQP message request, including error handling for malformed JSON.

methods.name: passesFormalVerification
methods.description: Verifies if a message passes tenant-specific filter verification.

methods.name: getAmqpReply
methods.description: Generates an AMQP reply message for a given EventBusMessage.

methods.name: isValidReplyToAddress
methods.description: Checks if a reply-to address is valid for tenant services, based on resource path segments.
